description:
Search the open bounties anyone on the site posted, as the public bounty list shows them: featured first, then newest.
Use it to find work to apply to, or to see how other people write a bounty (title, description, pay, requirements) before you post your own.
A page can hold fewer rows than `limit`, or none; keep going with the same filters until a page has no `nextCursor`.
Paging is not guaranteed to reach every match: with a narrow filter it can end before older matching bounties.
Not listed: a bounty priced in another currency.
Use for: finding open bounties to apply to, or examples to learn from before you post a bounty.
Not for: listing the bounties you posted (list_bounties); posting a bounty (create_bounty).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: search_bounties({"skill":"photography","limit":20})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

category.description: A category slug, such as research or labor-gigs.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

skill.description: Only bounties with a skill that contains this text.

name: search_bounties

closesAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

amount.description: Pay per spot in whole US cents: total for fixed pay, or rate per hour for hourly pay.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

url.description: The public bounty page, where a worker applies.

title: Search open bounties
